activity.notes: After the PPP victory in the 1957 election, Jagan returned as chief minister under the restored limited constitutional government. This term ended when the 1961 constitution created the office of Premier.

sources.title: Parliament of Guyana — History of Parliament
sources.citation_text: The parliamentary history records the 1957 election victory of the PPP under Cheddi Jagan and the constitutional transition to the premiership in 1961.

sources.title: Prime Minister of Guyana — historical office chronology
sources.citation_text: The office chronology gives Jagan's second chief-ministerial period from 21 August 1957 to 5 September 1961.
